decisions.reason: Close to the core offshore operations and operating since 2018, its prospects are sufficiently resolved and strategic, so it is kept as a low-risk option.
It builds on existing crew and travel operations, costs little to keep open, and demand uncertainty still justifies holding the option.
As a digital portal with higher uncertainty and ongoing costs, it has had several years without clear evidence of value, so the option is likely abandoned.
The mobile app is a low-cost add-on to existing vessel performance services, so it is kept open while its value remains uncertain.
